name: M3_OIS010MI_Upd
description: Update existing customer order type definitions used in customer order entry, pricing, logistics, and invoicing. This operation changes the configuration of one existing customer order type identified by its customer order type code. You can adjust identity and description, customer order category, number series, panel sequences, pricing and discount behavior, credit and risk controls, dispatch and invoicing options, statistics flags, and more, in line with the settings available in *CO Type. Open* (OIS010). The order type status field lets you enable or disable the type for new order entry: status 10 (Preliminary) and 90 (Blocked) prevent new customer orders, while status 20 (Definite) allows use. The update fails if the specified order type does not exist or has been removed by another user.
